items.example: Just chill out and watch TV.
items.simple: To rest and not be worried.
dialogue: A: I am so nervous about Monday.
B: Just chill out and watch TV.
items.note: Friends ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da çok sık.

items.example: Let's kick back and watch TV.
items.simple: To sit and rest. You do nothing hard.
dialogue: A: You look tired. Sit down.
B: Let's kick back and watch TV.
items.note: Friends ve The Big Bang Theory'de sık.

items.example: Back off! It's my turn.
items.simple: To move away or stop pushing someone.
dialogue: A: Let me use the game now!
B: Back off! It's my turn.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve Malcolm in the Middle'da.

items.example: Please shut up and listen.
items.simple: To stop talking. It can sound rude.
dialogue: A: But I have so much to say!
B: Please shut up and listen.
items.note: Kaba; arkadaşlar arası şakada çok sık.

items.example: I might bump into your ex today.
items.simple: To meet someone when you did not plan to.
dialogue: A: Guess who I saw at the shop?
B: I might bump into your ex today.
items.note: Friends ve HIMYM'de; "run into" ile aynı.

items.example: Can Ben sleep over tonight?
items.exampleTr: Ben bu gece bizde kalabilir mi?
items.simple: To sleep at a friend's house for one night.
dialogue: A: Mum, can I ask something?
B: Can Ben sleep over tonight?
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve Modern Family'de çocuklar için.

items.example: We always crack up at his jokes.
items.simple: To laugh a lot and not stop.
dialogue: A: Why is everybody so red in the face?
B: We always crack up at his jokes.
items.note: Friends ve The Office'te sık.

items.example: We have to dress up for dinner.
items.simple: To wear nice or special clothes.
dialogue: A: Is the restaurant fancy?
B: We have to dress up for dinner.
items.note: Modern Family'de parti sahneleri.

items.example: He wants to sneak out at night.
items.simple: To leave a place quietly so nobody sees you.
dialogue: A: Why is Tom so tired this morning?
B: He wants to sneak out at night.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da çok sık.

items.example: Don't storm off when you're angry.
items.simple: To go away fast because you are very angry.
dialogue: A: Where is Anna? She was here a minute ago.
B: Don't storm off when you're angry.
items.note: Friends ve Modern Family'de tartışma sonrası.

items.example: He would never stand someone up.
items.simple: To not come when you said you would meet someone.
dialogue: A: Why are you home so early?
B: He would never stand someone up.
items.note: HIMYM ve Friends'te randevu hikayeleri.

items.example: Don't mess with my sandwich.
items.simple: To touch or bother something that is not yours.
dialogue: A: I am just so hungry!
B: Don't mess with my sandwich.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine ve Malcolm in the Middle'da.

items.example: Stop trying to pick on your brother.
items.simple: To be mean to one person again and again.
dialogue: A: He called me names again, Dad!
B: Stop trying to pick on your brother.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'ın kardeş kavgalarında.

items.example: Can I crash at your place?
items.simple: To sleep at someone's home for a short time.
dialogue: A: I lost my keys, and it is late.
B: Can I crash at your place?
items.note: Friends ve The Big Bang Theory'de; günlük konuşma.

items.example: I'm going to head out. See you later.
items.simple: To leave a place and go somewhere.
dialogue: A: Are you leaving already?
B: I'm going to head out. See you later.
items.note: The Office ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da.

items.example: I'm going to go on a date tonight.
items.simple: To go out with a person you like.
dialogue: A: Why are you wearing a nice shirt?
B: I'm going to go on a date tonight.
items.note: HIMYM ve Friends'in ana konusu.

items.example: Let's throw a party on Saturday.
items.simple: To make a party at your home.
dialogue: A: The flat is big and we have no plans.
B: Let's throw a party on Saturday.
items.note: Modern Family ve HIMYM'de.

items.example: Let's make plans for Friday night.
items.simple: To decide with others what you will do.
dialogue: A: Are you free on Friday night?
B: Let's make plans for Friday night.
items.note: Her dizide; "Do you have plans?" çok sık.

items.example: Please don't make a scene here.
items.simple: To shout or act badly so everybody looks at you.
dialogue: A: This soup is cold! I will tell the waiter!
B: Please don't make a scene here.
items.note: Modern Family ve Seinfeld'de.

items.example: Come on, give it a shot.
items.simple: To try something, even if it is hard.
dialogue: A: I can not dance at all.
B: Come on, give it a shot.
items.note: Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da; "give it a try" gibi.

items.example: Oh, get a life!
items.simple: A rude joke to tell someone to find more fun things to do.
dialogue: A: I watched the same show nine times.
B: Oh, get a life!
items.note: Friends ve Seinfeld'de alaycı; kaba olabilir.

items.example: Don't worry, I'll pick up the bill.
items.simple: To pay for the food when you eat out.
dialogue: A: The waiter is coming. Who pays?
B: Don't worry, I'll pick up the bill.
items.note: How I Met Your Mother ve Friends'te restoran sahneleri.

items.example: I used to have a crush on my teacher.
items.simple: To like someone a lot but not tell them.
dialogue: A: Did you like anyone at school?
B: I used to have a crush on my teacher.
items.note: Friends ve Modern Family'de; genelde "crush on".

items.example: We always have a blast at the beach.
items.simple: To have a lot of fun.
dialogue: A: How was your holiday?
B: We always have a blast at the beach.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory ve HIMYM'de.

items.example: I'm having a bad day.
items.simple: A day when many things go wrong.
dialogue: A: You look upset. What happened?
B: I'm having a bad day.
items.note: Her dizide; dert yanma.

items.example: He didn't take the hint and stayed.
items.simple: To understand what someone means without clear words.
dialogue: A: I yawned ten times, but he stayed.
B: He didn't take the hint and stayed.
items.note: The Big Bang Theory ve The Office'te.
